babs.1: He is not a liar who makes peace between people
babs.2: The imam saying to his companions: "Come with us to make peace"
babs.3: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "… that they make a settlement between them, and settlement is better"
babs.4: If they agree on an unjust settlement, the settlement is rejected
babs.5: How to write: "This is what so-and-so son of so-and-so and so-and-so son of so-and-so have agreed on"
babs.8: The Prophet's ﷺ saying about al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī: "This son of mine is a chief"
babs.9: May the imam suggest a settlement?
babs.10: The virtue of reconciling people and being just among them
babs.11: If the imam suggests a settlement and it is refused
babs.13: Settlement with debt and with cash
